use_UnitTypes_get_id: use UnitTypes.get_id to look up the numeric ID for a named unit type like PEASANT or DRAGON
use_CmdTypes_enum: use the CmdTypes enum to classify game commands into IDLE, GATHER, ATTACK, BUILD_BUILDING, BUILD_UNIT, MOVE, or CONT
use_RuleAction_enum: use the RuleAction enum to represent rule-based AI actions like BUILD_PEASANT, ATTACK_BASE, SCOUT, or GATHER
use_instruction_masks: use good_inst_mask or better_inst_mask numpy arrays to filter valid instruction indices for the MiniRTS dataset
use_Terrain_and_Visibility_enums: use the Terrain and Visibility enums to represent map tile types and unit visibility states in the game
